description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-negative rods in tangled clumps.
description.detailed_description: This is a gram stain image showing gram-negative rods that are arranged in loosely tangled clumps. The rods appear straight to slightly fusiform, with some showing lateral bulbar swelling. The background is pink, consistent with the gram-negative staining, and the rods are stained purple. The image demonstrates characteristic morphology of the organism, which may be inhibited by sodium polyanethol sulfonate (SPS) in certain culture media.
visible_findings: lateral bulbar swelling in some rods
